data.name: Cli_HelpSprd
data.value: SPRD: --protocol sprd --port COMx (or --usb VID:PID). Entry detection is automatic by default; optional --sprd-entry auto|brom|fdl1|fdl2. Detected Boot ROM requires --loader FDL1.bin --sprd-fdl1-address ADDRESS --sprd-fdl2 FDL2.bin --sprd-fdl2-address ADDRESS; FDL1 only requires FDL2, and FDL2 uploads no loader. Automatic FDL2 entry negotiates unescaped frames; unknown stages require an explicit entry. Capacity source defaults to auto: validate GPT first, then query a native list only when unavailable and the read session has been acknowledged closed; optional --sprd-partition-source auto|native|gpt. Corrupt or ambiguous GPT never downgrades. Native lists still require --sprd-partition-unit BYTES (bytes per size unit); units and physical formats are not guessed. GPT sectors default to validated automatic detection; optional --sprd-sector-size auto|512|4096. --sprd-gpt-bytes BYTES defaults to 32768, at most 4 MiB. Length layout: --sprd-length 32|64|64-reserved. Raw download defaults off; use a confirmed --sprd-raw-mode v1|v2 --sprd-raw-flush BYTES (at most 4 MiB); USB also requires --sprd-raw-usb-packet BYTES. Compatibility: --sprd-pad-odd, --sprd-disable-transcode, --sprd-entry-transcode-disabled. Resource wait defaults to 30 seconds and must be finite. Commands: connect, info, sprd-chip-uid, partitions all, read boot boot.img, write boot boot.img, erase boot, reboot system|poweroff. NV writes/erase, whole-disk sector access, DIAG, repartition and browser/LP are unavailable.

data.value: Interactive mode keeps its session. Use reconnect [auto|brom|da1|da2] [xflash|legacy|xml]. Startup evidence and the previous session are preferred; unknown stage/identity needs confirmation. Legacy DA2 requires previous storage geometry. Scatter flash/update shows only mismatches; after approval, back up only the current GPT, update, and flash. No backup of all partitions. mtk-scatter to-gpt scatter-file output-prefix emmc|ufs block-size user-capacity mtk-scatter from-gpt gpt-file scatter-file emmc|ufs block-size user-capacity platform Conversions run offline. Capacity is in bytes; block size is 512 or 4096. to-gpt outputs .pgpt.bin/.sgpt.bin; from-gpt disables downloads and does not guess image filenames. GPT contains only the USER layout.

data.value: MTK commands (existing mtk-* aliases remain compatible): mtk probe | capabilities mtk seccfg lock|unlock [--backup file] mtk slot read | set a|b [--backup file] mtk rpmb info [--region 0..3] mtk rpmb read|write file [--region N] [--start block] [--count blocks] [--key-file key] mtk rpmb erase [--region N] [--start block] [--count blocks] [--key-file key] mtk rpmb auth key-file [--region N] mtk rpmb-lock read|lock|unlock [--key-file key] [--backup file] mtk key Rpmb|Fde|Tee|RootOfTrust|... output-file mtk memory read|write address length file mtk register read address | write address value mtk partition read|write name file [--maximum bytes] | erase name mtk scatter [file] | plan file | flash|update file [image-directory] [--backup directory] mtk efuse read file | write file [--backup file] mtk query query-name output-file | property key output-file mtk pmt 32|64|96|disk|xml mtk fill region offset length byte-value | rsc partition file seccfg/slot resolve partition geometry automatically; use --partition for an ambiguous target. RPMB blocks are 256 bytes; region/start default to zero. Read/erase use remaining confirmed capacity; writes use file block count. Without a key file, reuse current authentication or derive with Penumbra2. Keys are never logged or implicitly saved. Unknown UFS capacity still requires confirmation. Safety-sensitive writes require backup/confirmation. Unknown writes are not retried; addresses, unknown capacities and OEM keys are not guessed.
